title: Advanced Data Structures and Algorithms: Main Exam, 17 December 2018
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS.

parts.text: Explain the following terms as used in mathematics for algorithms.
Difference of sets
Complement of a set
Cross product
Partition of a set
Explain the following data types as used in data structures.
Structured data types
Abstract data types
Atomic/basic data type
What is a digraph? Use the necessary diagrams to illustrate your explanation.
What is an algorithm? List down any four features of a good algorithm.
Explain how the aggregate method can be used to implement amortized analysis in stack operations.
Explain the concept of "spanning trees" and give reasons as to why they are important.
What is the difference between linear equality and linear inequality? Explain the geometric interpretation of equalities in terms of the x-axis and the y-axis.
What is a dynamic programming algorithm? Explain any three basic elements that characterize dynamic programming algorithms.
List any four applications of finite automata.
Explain the concept of "transpose" as used in graphs.
Explain any three reasons as to why we study data structures.
List down any five definitions of an algorithm, according to Abu Jafar Muhammad Ibn Musa Al-Khowarizmi.
What is a graph? Explain the difference between directed graphs and undirected graphs.
Briefly describe the term "fraction" in terms of structural and behavioural definitions.
Explain the following terms as used in mathematical algorithms.
Set
Set cardinality
